how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blasted-lands-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2522:title: Kum'isha's Endeavors
rows.quest:2522:progress:0: Have you found another flawless draenethyst sphere?
rows.quest:2522:completion:0: Simply amazing. I had doubted that you could find another sphere, yet here it is, pulsating in my hands.⟦1⟧⟦2⟧Well done, ⟦3⟧!⟦4⟧⟦5⟧Should you find anymore--and I believe this to be an impossibility--return them to me and I shall reward you again.
rows.quest:2582:title: Rage of Ages
rows.quest:2582:desc:0: Bring three ⟦E4⟧, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one ⟦E5⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2582:obj:0: Bring three ⟦E4⟧, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one ⟦E5⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2582:details:0: Bring three ⟦E4⟧, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one ⟦E5⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2582:progress:0: Do you have the beast organs?
rows.quest:2582:completion:0: There you go! Remember, use it sparingly. If you require another, come see me after you finish the one you currently have in your possession.
rows.quest:2584:title: Spirit of the Boar
rows.quest:2584:desc:0: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one ⟦E8⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2584:obj:0: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one ⟦E8⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2584:details:0: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one ⟦E8⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2584:completion:0: I must warn you, ⟦7⟧, do not attempt to mix the formulas I have created. The chemical properties of the formula you most recently ingested will always take precedence over former enchantments; thus, rendering the other formulation null.
rows.quest:2586:title: ⟦E9⟧ of the Scorpok
rows.quest:2586:desc:0: Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2586:obj:0: Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2586:details:0: Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2586:completion:0: Fine work, ⟦9⟧. Here is one sample of the assay for you and the remaining nine will be used in my research.⟦10⟧⟦11⟧Anytime you require more of the ground scorpok assay, return to me and we shall work out a deal.
rows.quest:2602:title: Infallible Mind
rows.quest:2602:desc:0: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2602:obj:0: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2602:details:0: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2602:progress:0: Have you returned with the requested organs?
rows.quest:2602:completion:0: Yes, yes, give me a moment and more of the compound will be ready for your consumption, ⟦12⟧.⟦13⟧⟦14⟧Take it... and ⟦15⟧, do not attempt to consume these experimental concoctions in rapid succession. The results could be disastrous.
rows.quest:2604:title: Spiritual Domination
rows.quest:2604:desc:0: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2604:obj:0: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2604:details:0: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2604:progress:0: Do not waste my time, ⟦16⟧. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
rows.quest:2604:completion:0: Perhaps one day I shall be able to isolate the active enzymes of this assay and produce a much more efficient resultant. Unfortunately, you will have to settle for what I am currently able to produce. Return to me should you require more gizzard gum.
rows.quest:3502:title: One Draenei's Junk...
rows.quest:3502:desc:0: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the ⟦E14⟧ could be carrying a fragment.
rows.quest:3502:obj:0: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the ⟦E14⟧ could be carrying a fragment.
rows.quest:3502:details:0: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the ⟦E14⟧ could be carrying a fragment.
rows.quest:3502:progress:0: Well? Draenethyst? Remember?⟦17⟧⟦18⟧<Kum'isha clenches his fist and knocks on your head.>⟦19⟧⟦20⟧Is anybody home?
rows.quest:3502:completion:0: You truly disgust me, ⟦21⟧. A grown woman drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight.⟦22⟧⟦23⟧Sounds familiar? It should, because I say it a thousand times per day.⟦24⟧⟦25⟧Oh how I loathe this world.
rows.quest:2581:obj:0: Bring three ⟦E4⟧, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one ⟦E5⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2581:details:0: It is a well known fact that hyenas possess tremendous strength in their jowls, but the strength to snap through three inches of thorium steel? Impossible, improbable, and yet I have seen this demonstrated with my own eyes.
rows.quest:2581:details:1: Venture forth, into the ⟦E14⟧, and bring me three snickerfang jowls. As you search for the snickerfang, be on the lookout for boars and scorpoks: The initial assay also requires two blasted boar lungs and one scorpok pincer to complete.
rows.quest:2581:progress:0: You smell foul, ⟦26⟧. Have you been traipsing in sulfur fields? And where are my components?!
rows.quest:2581:completion:0: How do you feel, ⟦27⟧? You radiate with the aura of the snickerfang--your strength, unmatched by mortals!
rows.quest:2581:completion:1: Unfortunately, with the components you brought to me, I could only make enough of the assay for one tablet. I will require more components, should you require another tablet.
rows.quest:2583:obj:0: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one ⟦E8⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.⟦28⟧
rows.quest:2583:details:0: Within these blasted lands exists two species of boar: the ash-mane boar and the helboar.
rows.quest:2583:details:1: It would appear that the stamina of these beasts renders them nearly immune to harm, as the other animals find them too difficult to kill and consequently, not worth the effort.
rows.quest:2583:details:2: We need to perform further analysis, ⟦29⟧. Should you bring me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain, I shall create a divine elixir from the residue of the assay. You will be my first test subject!
rows.quest:2583:completion:0: The spirit of the boar illuminates your being, ⟦31⟧! I wonder, do you believe yourself to be as invulnerable as these beasts?
rows.quest:2585:obj:0: Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one ⟦E10⟧ to ⟦E6⟧.⟦32⟧
rows.quest:2585:details:0: Have you ever watched them in battle, ⟦33⟧? The scorpoks, I mean. Have you ever seen the grace and agility with which they move? The decisiveness of their strikes?
rows.quest:2585:details:1: If only we could somehow isolate that agility and encapsulate it, we would be wealthy beyond our... I mean... it would be a boon for the scientific community.
rows.quest:2585:details:2: Assist me, ⟦34⟧, and I shall allow you a sampling of the assay.
rows.quest:2585:details:3: In order to create a stable sample, I will need three scorpok pincers, two vulture gizzards, and one blasted boar lung.
rows.quest:2585:completion:0: Fascinating. This has been the most difficult of all assays to analyze.
rows.quest:2585:completion:1: Take a pinch of this residual salt and place it under your tongue. You should experience a slight feeling of euphoria followed by a state of unprecedented agility and quickness.
rows.quest:2601:obj:0: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to ⟦E11⟧.⟦38⟧
rows.quest:2601:details:0: These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, ⟦39⟧. These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.
rows.quest:2601:details:1: I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.
rows.quest:2601:details:3: Retrieve ten of their brains for me, ⟦40⟧. The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.
rows.quest:2601:progress:0: Have you returned with the requested organs?
rows.quest:2601:completion:0: This is wondrous, ⟦41⟧! My offering to you is a taste of the inner workings of the redstone basilisk.
rows.quest:2601:completion:1: Should the compound be to your liking, more can always be made... for a price.
rows.quest:2603:obj:0: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E11⟧.⟦42⟧
rows.quest:2603:details:0: Death does indeed have wings in these blasted lands, ⟦43⟧. I have witnessed the black slayers and bonepickers feasting upon the corpse of many a fallen explorer - sometimes feeding upon the most vile and disease ridden of carcasses. It is a wonder, then, how their internal systems overcome the pestilence that claims these lands.
rows.quest:2603:details:1: Assist me in my studies, ⟦44⟧! Gizzards I need! Two snickerfang jowls will also be required for the base of the concoction.
rows.quest:2603:details:2: You shall be rewarded two-fold for your efforts.
rows.quest:2603:progress:0: Do not waste my time, ⟦45⟧. We have nothing to discuss, unless you have recovered the items I have requested.
rows.quest:2603:completion:0: Most excellent! I shall get to work immediately. Perhaps a cure for many of the ailments of the world is to be found!
rows.quest:2603:completion:1: Ah yes, your reward - of course, should you require more of the gum, return to me and another task you shall be given.
rows.quest:2621:details:0: Regret. It is all I have now. One bad decision resulting in several horrible outcomes. If only I had waited for those orders. Maybe they would have detailed the horrors that awaited us in those cursed lands! Maybe they were to redirect us to another detail? Ultimately, it was my fault. All of it was my fault.
rows.quest:2621:details:1: So here I stand, awaiting orders. I must know. I must have those orders.
rows.quest:2621:details:2: ⟦E19⟧ resides in Stonard. Find him and find out what became of the orders.⟦46⟧
rows.quest:2621:completion:0: ⟦E20⟧'s Grasp... The story is still fresh in my mind.
rows.quest:2621:completion:2: Terrible thing that happened to that regiment. The horde lost some of its best soldiers when that battalion was destroyed.
rows.quest:2784:obj:0: Listen to the ⟦E21⟧ tell his story.
rows.quest:2784:progress:0: Listen to what I have to say.
rows.quest:2784:completion:0: As a spirit, I am powerless, ⟦48⟧. Assist me. Allow me to regain my honor.
rows.quest:2521:obj:0: In your journeys throughout the ⟦E14⟧, should you ever come across a ⟦E1⟧, take the item back to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2521:obj:1: Be warned, this gem is one of the most rare crystals in all of ⟦E22⟧. Any creature in these lands could be holding a ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2521:obj:2: You will be rewarded for each ⟦E1⟧ you have collected.
rows.quest:2521:details:0: ⟦49⟧, can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.
rows.quest:2521:details:1: So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, ⟦50⟧... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
rows.quest:2521:progress:0: I have dedicated my life to the search of flawless draenethyst spheres. A lifetime, ⟦51⟧!
rows.quest:2521:completion:0: Do my eyes deceive me? Impossible! Where did you... How...
rows.quest:2521:completion:1: Perhaps now a rift can be opened, returning us to our homeland.
rows.quest:3501:obj:0: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.⟦52⟧
rows.quest:3501:details:0: Although you may never find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, you will undoubtedly uncover various imperfect fragments of the draenethyst in your exploration of these lands.
rows.quest:3501:details:1: While it is doubtful that Kum'isha will be able to use the flawed fragments to return home, the pieces may serve other, useful purposes for the draenei.
rows.quest:3501:details:2: Return any piece of flawed draenethyst fragments that you may find and I shall reward you.
rows.quest:3501:progress:0: Have you had any luck in your exploration?
rows.quest:3501:completion:0: You truly disgust me, ⟦53⟧. A grown man drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight.
rows.quest:2681:obj:0: Free nine Servants of Razelikh, three Servants of Sevine, three Servants of Allistarj, and three Servants of Grol. Return to the Fallen Hero when your task is complete. You must remain within close proximity of the stones or the process will fail.
rows.quest:2681:details:0: It will take more than you alone to overcome the forces of Razelikh and his subordinates.
rows.quest:2681:details:1: Gather a suitable group of adventurers and free my men of their eternal torture! Eighteen stones you must shatter.
rows.quest:2681:details:2: Fight hard and die with honor, ⟦54⟧.
rows.quest:2681:progress:0: It is no easy task, ⟦55⟧. Do not give up!
rows.quest:2681:completion:0: You have done it, ⟦56⟧! The poor, tortured souls can finally rest.
rows.quest:2681:completion:1: Our work is not yet over, ⟦57⟧. We have much to discuss and much more to accomplish.
rows.quest:2701:obj:0: Open the chest and claim your reward.
rows.quest:2701:details:0: Please, take from this a relic of old. We no longer have a use for the item.
rows.quest:2701:details:1: May it serve you well in your fight against the legion.⟦58⟧
rows.quest:2701:completion:0: You are temporarily blinded by the sparkle and gleam.
rows.quest:2702:details:0: You have honored me with your nobility and heroism, ⟦59⟧.
rows.quest:2702:completion:0: Indeed, you have honored us all. Our thanks alone are not sufficient.
rows.quest:2783:obj:0: Speak with the ⟦E21⟧ at the border of the ⟦E14⟧ and the swamp.
rows.quest:2783:details:1: The true power in these lands continues to grow in strength and number while we squabble over scorched earth with orcs.
rows.quest:2783:details:2: Do we continue to fight a war in these lands against the ⟦E26⟧, only to be routed one day by the armies of the ⟦E27⟧? It is futile.
rows.quest:2783:details:3: Put your differences aside, ⟦61⟧, speak with the fallen hero of the ⟦E26⟧. He knows the truth behind the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:2783:completion:1: I thought to never see this day again. A day in which the ⟦E28⟧ fights side by side with the ⟦E26⟧ against a common enemy.
rows.quest:2783:completion:2: It shall be... we will unite.
rows.quest:2801:obj:0: Listen to the ⟦E21⟧ tell his story.
rows.quest:2801:details:0: Before we may continue, you must hear my story.
rows.quest:2801:progress:0: Listen to what I have to say, ⟦62⟧.
rows.quest:2801:completion:0: The time to act is now, ⟦63⟧.
rows.quest:2721:obj:0: Find out what became of Lieutenant ⟦E29⟧.
rows.quest:2721:details:0: As one chapter of your adventure closes, another one begins, ⟦64⟧.
rows.quest:2721:details:1: One of my men is still unaccounted for, lost somewhere in the ⟦E14⟧. I am talking about Lieutenant ⟦E29⟧, of course.
rows.quest:2721:details:2: As I had mentioned earlier, we were both imprisoned and tortured by Allistarj, but poor ⟦E29⟧, his strength of will faltered. I could hear the experiments from my cage; the tortured screams rang through the halls of the cave. That was the last I saw or heard of ⟦E29⟧.
rows.quest:2743:obj:0: Return to the ⟦E21⟧ with your findings.
rows.quest:2743:details:0: Let us not mince words, ⟦65⟧; my time here is limited.
rows.quest:2743:details:1: You must destroy the triad of power which protects the demon lord, Razelikh. Doing so will not be as simple a task as freeing a damned soul.
rows.quest:2743:details:3: You see, each of Razelikh's underlings wears a third of an amulet of Razelikh's creation around their neck. The very same amulet you will need in order to summon the arch demon.
rows.quest:2743:details:4: Return to Trebor and tell him what is required to summon Razelikh. He will be able to instruct you further.
rows.quest:2743:completion:0: The demon lord displays a cunning almost as calculated as his brutality, ⟦66⟧.
rows.quest:2744:details:0: The triad is protected by Razelikh.
rows.quest:2744:details:1: In exchange for their servitude, Razelikh granted each of them nearly unlimited power within the ⟦E14⟧. The amulet pieces are each attuned to the lifeforce of their owner, granting them immortality. As long as they remain within the ⟦E14⟧, they cannot be slain, their life spans extended until the end of days.
rows.quest:2744:details:2: There is one who may be able to assist you further, ⟦67⟧. ⟦E33⟧ to ⟦E32⟧ and find the demon hunter, ⟦E31⟧. Search the islands.
rows.quest:2744:completion:0: I will help you. Although, I do not think you fully understand what you are up against.
rows.quest:3627:obj:0: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and ⟦E34⟧. From their corpses take the ⟦E35⟧, the ⟦E36⟧, and the ⟦E37⟧.
rows.quest:3627:obj:1: Remember to USE your ⟦E38⟧ to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...⟦68⟧
rows.quest:3627:details:0: To reach the Defiler, you must first destroy the triad of power and recover the amulet pieces. When you recover all three pieces, return to me and I shall give you further instruction.
rows.quest:3627:details:1: Go ⟦69⟧! To the ⟦E14⟧! Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol must fall!⟦70⟧
rows.quest:3627:progress:0: The three shall form the one, the one shall light the way.
rows.quest:3627:completion:0: The amulet of ⟦E39⟧ is once again complete but he senses the disruption in his chain of command. He knows you come for him...
rows.quest:3628:obj:0: Destroy ⟦E39⟧ and return the ⟦E40⟧ to the ⟦E21⟧. You will also need to return the ⟦E41⟧ so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.⟦71⟧
rows.quest:3628:details:0: Razelikh's lair is atop the highest mountain in the ⟦E14⟧. The only way to the lair is through the use of the teleport runes near the mountain. As long as you hold the amulet, you can freely transport up to the lair. Once you reach the lair, you must conjure the beast. The amulet is your key, ⟦72⟧. Use it on the Altar of the Defiler.
rows.quest:3628:details:1: Should you defeat the Defiler, bring back his horn. It will become a symbol of hope for all that view it - proof that heroes do exist in this war torn world.⟦73⟧
rows.quest:3628:progress:0: There is nothing left to fear.⟦74⟧⟦75⟧
rows.quest:3628:completion:0: Today is a day that will be remembered for all eternity. The demonic overlord of the ⟦E14⟧ has finally fallen!
